verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs describe a Model Aliasing feature that lets developers give a model a simpler, custom nickname and call it by that name, which matches assigning a custom identifier for API reference. The evidence is a single homepage announcement with no configuration or API-usage detail. missing for 10: documentation of how aliases are configured (config file/field syntax), explicit confirmation that aliases resolve in OpenAI-compatible API model parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls

citations.quote: Model Aliasing: You can now set up model aliases, meaning you can call your favorite complex model name by a simpler, custom nickname.
